subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw expose `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in hosted no-auth web search provider even though Firecrawl's public API docs still require bearer-token authentication?
rationale: Automation can verify the code shape and a live no-auth probe, but it cannot decide whether OpenClaw should endorse an undocumented hosted search path for user queries or own the compatibility/support risk of a new public provider id.

options.title: Require explicit approval before merge
options.body: Merge only after Firecrawl documents or otherwise confirms the no-auth search contract, or an OpenClaw maintainer records an explicit exception and the branch is rebased cleanly.

options.title: Keep Firecrawl search keyed
options.body: Reject the new provider id for now and, if useful, keep only the richer keyed `firecrawl_search` options in a narrower PR.

options.title: Accept the undocumented opt-in risk
options.body: Maintainership can intentionally accept the live-but-undocumented no-auth behavior as an experimental opt-in provider and own future support if Firecrawl changes it.

recommendation.title: Require explicit approval before merge
recommendation.body: Merge only after Firecrawl documents or otherwise confirms the no-auth search contract, or an OpenClaw maintainer records an explicit exception and the branch is rebased cleanly.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent keyless Firecrawl scrape work and the key-free web-search opt-in policy that governs this decision.
